mentions.heading: Success of acquisitions depends on realizing expected benefits from combining businesses
mentions.detail: Generic statement; integration of acquired businesses may fail to deliver synergies, cause unknown liabilities and costs
mentions.quote: If we are unsuccessful in combining companies, the anticipated benefits of the acquisitions may not be realized fully or at all or may take longer to realize than expected. Further, there is potential for unknown or inestimable liabilities relating to the acquired businesses.

mentions.heading: We may not be able to execute dispositions of assets or businesses successfully.
mentions.detail: Generic statement; buyer indemnities may not protect; negative synergies from separation possible
mentions.quote: We cannot be assured that any of these indemnification provisions will fully protect us, and, as a result, may face unexpected liabilities that adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

mentions.heading: We may not be able to execute dispositions of assets or businesses successfully.
mentions.detail: Disposition closings require regulatory and governmental approvals in jurisdictions worldwide
mentions.quote: Such regulatory and governmental approvals may be required in jurisdictions around the world, and any delays in the timing of such approvals could materially delay or prevent the transaction.

mentions.heading: Conditions in the automotive industry may adversely affect our business.
mentions.detail: Depends on global automotive and truck production; sensitive to interest rates, consumer credit, trade issues
mentions.quote: Economic declines that result in significant reduction in automotive or truck production would result in a decline in the production levels of our major customers and, by extension, in our sales to OEMs which would adversely affect our business, results of operations, cash flows and financial condition.
